messages:
mia (AM): Heads-up: Praxis Diagnostics wants a 3-week POC. Primary asks: test 6B-int4 for cost, and a 30B-quantized fp16-ish variant for quality comparisons. Procurement also asked about EU data residency and whether weights can be pinned to dedicated hardware. They quoted ~200M tokens/month target for the POC.

 dan (sales-eng): POC pricing ask: customer requests a fixed POC rate instead of token-based for predictability. Suggested approach: hosted token rate with 35% off for trial period OR a flat $X/month for POC volume. Which is easier to approve? :thinking_face:

 riley (infra): 35% off hosted looks easier. For dedicated pinning: we can store weights on isolated volumes in eu-west-1 and use customer-specific KMS keys. Full hardware pinning (single-tenant host) is possible only on Private deployments.

 ofer (ml eng): Can run a compat check if someone drops the HF id. Important to note: the 30B quantized variant often ships with a custom rotary embedding op; our runtime may need a fallback kernel. That can increase latency a bit.

 mia (AM): HF id: hf.co/praxis/diag-summarizer-v4. They said avg token ~600, peak ~4096 for batch tests.

 infra-bot: Model registry scan complete: hf.co/praxis/diag-summarizer-v4 (v4.1) found. Checksum OK.

 ofer (ml eng): Ran compat pass: `./compat-run --model hf://praxis/diag-summarizer-v4 --quant int4,quant30b --runtime rwd-v3`
Findings: tokenizer matches; int4 export has custom fused attention (rotary variant) that our int4 kernels do not cover -> runtime falls back to generic kernel on that op. For quant30b variant (30B quantized to 4/8 hybrid) there is a minor fused op mismatch requiring a patched kernel. Expected perf impact: int4 fallback +15-25% on affected sequences, 30B patch requires a runtime micro-patch but GPU perf stays within ~+10% of baseline.

 zara (solutions): Customer requests latency numbers (600 / 4096) and an eval harness they can run. Can we get quick benchmarks by EOD? Also need a written answer for weights isolation for procurement.

 ofer (ml eng): Quick single-rep numbers (batch=1):
- 6B-int4 (dedicated with fallback): 600 -> 78ms avg, 4096 -> 420ms avg
- 30B-quant (hosted multi-tenant with patched runtime): 600 -> 290ms avg, 4096 -> 1.5s avg
I’ll kick off a 24h perf/throughput run tonight and upload CSV.

 riley (infra): Routing plan sketch: primary route to dedicated 6B-int4; fallback to hosted 30B-quant for complex queries or when latency >1200ms. Add region pin to eu-west-1 for residency. Pseudoconfig:
```
route {
  primary: praxis/6b-int4@dedicated-eu
  fallback: praxis/30b-quant@hosted-eu
  p99_timeout_ms: 1200
  logs: enabled
}
```
Will mark pool reservation as tentative until legal signs off on POC terms.

 dan (sales-eng): Procurement wants a one-paragraph summary for EU residency + weights isolation: can we state: "POC traffic and logs are pinned to eu-west-1 and model artifacts are stored on isolated volumes encrypted with customer-isolated KMS keys. For private deployments, HSM-backed key storage and single-tenant hardware options are available." Is that accurate?

 riley (infra): Yes, accurate. Add that audit logs and access events are retained per the enterprise SLA.

 zara (solutions): Drafting security Q answers now and will put a short SOW snippet re: region pinning, fallback behavior, and the 35% POC discount for the first 30 days. Also will note the runtime patch requirement for the 30B variant so customer understands the small compatibility work.

 mia (AM): Action list: (1) ofer: 24h perf CSV + short eval note about fallback impact (2) zara: security questionnaire text + SOW snippet (3) dan: procurement blurb with pricing options (flat vs discounted token rate) (4) riley: tentatively reserve dedicated 6B pool and confirm instance types and capacity. Need everything ASAP to get MSA signed.

 ofer (ml eng): Starting 24h perf run now and will upload CSV to artifacts once done. Note: int4 fallback will affect cost parity; I'll include cost-per-1k-token comparisons both with and without fallback included.

 infra-bot: Job queued: reserve-dedicated-praxis-6b (id: job-2026-03-21-99).

 riley (infra): Reserved a 5-node 6B pool (eu-west-1, expected: g5g.large family-equivalent). Estimated sustained throughput ~8k tokens/s. Will confirm replica sizing in an hour.

 dan (sales-eng): Drafting procurement note now. Will include both pricing options and recommend the token-discount path to avoid flat pricing negotiations.

 zara (solutions): Uploaded draft security answers to #sales-docs and added the runtime patch note so engineering is looped in.

 mia (AM): Thanks team. If the 24h perf + security answers look good we can finalize POC terms tomorrow and schedule kickoff. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
